'''2001 GenCon Coruscant Sealed Deck (5 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held at Gen Con on 5 August 2001. It is known from Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2820">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-10-continentals-2k1-day-2d2820/ continentals-2k1-day-2], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 10 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-10-continentals-2k1-day-2d2820/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 North American Continental Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 5 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Gen Con
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
